description: gen schema refuses an object whose two distinct field spellings translate to one snake_case identifier — qStart renders q_start beside a field already spelled q_start — naming the colliding field and the reason, exit 1, writing nothing. Like every codegen refusal the line carries no registered code, so the pinned expectation is the one-line refusal itself, and the scratch check proves nothing was written into the output directory

stderr-contains: kdlith: gen schema: the field `q_start` of `Thing` has no Rust spelling in a generated crate: another one in the same declaration spells the same identifier
